VSOL V1600D16 16-Port EPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal for Scalable Fiber Networks

The V1600D16 is a 16-port EPON OLT designed to deliver superior performance and scalability for large-scale fiber-optic deployments. This high-capacity OLT is perfect for service providers, telecom operators, and large enterprises looking for a reliable and cost-effective solution for FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home) and FTTP (Fiber-to-the-Premises) applications. With dual power modules (AC/DC), hot-swappable design, and flexible uplink options, the V1600D16 guarantees uninterrupted operation and efficient network management in high-demand environments.


Key Features 

  • 16 EPON Ports – Supports up to 1024 ONUs with a 1:64 splitting ratio per port for high-density deployments.
  • High-Speed Uplinks – 4 GE RJ45 ports, 4 GE SFP ports, and 4 x 10GE SFP+ ports for seamless, high-speed data transfer.
  • Dual Power Modules (AC/DC) – Hot-swappable design ensures continuous power supply, minimizing downtime during maintenance.
  • Compact & Efficient – 1U rack-mountable design for easy installation in network cabinets and data centers.
  • Low Power Consumption – Provides high network throughput with low energy consumption.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600D16
  • PON Ports: 16 x EPON (PX20++, PX20+ compatible)
  • Uplink Ports: 4 x 1GE RJ45 + 4 x GE SFP + 4 x 10GE SFP+
  • Splitting Ratio: 1:64 per PON port
  • Backplane Bandwidth: 128 Gbps
  • Port Forwarding Rate: 95.232 Mpps
  • Power Supply: Dual AC/DC options (100-240V AC, -36V to -75V DC)
  • Power Consumption: 95W (Energy Efficient)
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)
  • Chassis: 1U 19-inch rack-mountable design
  • Weight: 6.5kg

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH / FTTP / FTTB Networks – Provides high-speed connectivity for residential and business customers.
  • Large Enterprise & Corporate Networks – Supports high-capacity applications with multiple uplink options.
  • Telecom & ISP Providers – Efficient, cost-effective solution for large-scale broadband services.
  • Smart City & IoT Solutions – Perfect for connecting sensors, devices, and IoT systems in smart cities.


Why Choose the V1600D16 16-Port EPON OLT?

  • Massive Scalability – Supports up to 1024 ONUs for high-density fiber deployments.
  • Redundant Power Supply – Dual AC/DC power inputs for uninterrupted performance in critical environments.
  • Hot-Swappable Power Modules – Ensure continuous operation with minimal downtime during maintenance.
  • Energy-Efficient – Low power consumption for cost-effective, high-performance networking.
